headline.text: Drone attack in Kuwait kills two Italian workers
headline.context: Kuwait blames Iran, which denies any role.
headline.vo: Two Italian technicians have been killed in a drone attack in Kuwait. Kuwait says the drones were Iranian. Iran denies any involvement.

beats.vo: Kuwait's army says several drones entered its airspace on Thursday afternoon and targeted what it called a vital site. The two Italians worked for the defence company Rheinmetall, maintaining air-defence antennas. Officials say they were hit by falling shrapnel from intercepted drones.

beats.label: people injured, Kuwait's army says
beats.vo: Four people were hurt, Kuwait says. The two Italians later died. A Kuwaiti and a Pakistani were also injured.

beats.quote: The incident is suspicious and looks like a precooked recipe for war.
beats.vo: Iran's foreign minister, Abbas Araghchi, says Iran had no role, and has proposed a joint investigation with Kuwait. Italy's prime minister, Giorgia Meloni, expressed her deepest sorrow. Iran has stepped up attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain over the past week.

title: Two Italian workers killed in drone attack in Kuwait, Iran denies role
caption: Two Italian technicians working for Rheinmetall were killed when drones targeted a military site in Kuwait on Thursday, Kuwait's army says. Kuwait and Italy say the drones were Iranian; Iran denies any involvement and has proposed a joint investigation. It is the first deadly strike in Kuwait in months, as tensions in the Gulf rise again.
